answer: Influence in this economy comes from coin-age: tokens held unmoved slowly gather weight, the way a banked ember keeps its heat, and moving or splitting them resets the clock. Because the total is conserved, a farm that divides one wallet across fifty heads gets fifty slivers adding up to the same weight, and each fresh split starts near zero. No head can step onto a ledge of influence its parent wallet never earned, and a beacon-timed snapshot stops anyone shuffling coins just before a vote.
